::: {#exm-subset-transitive}
#### A chain of subsets

Let $D$ be the disk of @exr-disk-square,
and let $H = \set{(x, y) \in \reals \times \reals : x + y \le 2}$.
@sol-disk-square shows that $D \subseteq [-1, 1] \times [-1, 1]$.
Every point $(x, y)$ of $[-1, 1] \times [-1, 1]$ has $x \le 1$ and $y \le 1$, so $x + y \le 2$,
and so $[-1, 1] \times [-1, 1] \subseteq H$.
By @thm-subset-transitive, $D \subseteq H$.

:::
